ns2:course.label: Nuclear Power Econ & Fuel Mgmt
ns2:course.description: (NPRE 312) Quantitative analysis of the impact of the nuclear power industry; nuclear fuel cycle and capital costs for thermal and fast reactors; optimization of the use of nuclear fuels to provide the lowest energy costs and highest system performance; and comparison between fossil fuel systems, fission systems, and controlled thermonuclear fusion systems. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Junior standing; NPRE 402 / ME 405 or NPRE 247; or consent of instructor.
